core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghalia corresponds to the Arabic form غالية (Arabic root غ ل و (gh-l-w); غالية (Ghāliya)). Its core sense is precious, dear, expensive. Ghalia is Arabic غالية (Ghāliya) 'precious, dear (feminine)' — and also the name of a classical aromatic compound/perfume (ghāliya). The source gave only the Latin string 'Ghalia' for the script form and glossed it 'sweetness, delight'; the lexical sense is 'precious, dear'.
